Definition: the arm (as stretched out), or (of animals) the foreleg; figuratively, force
BiblicalUsage: 1) arm, forearm, shoulder, strength; 1a) arm; 1b) arm (as symbol of strength); 1c) forces (political and military); 1d) shoulder (of animal sacrificed)
